author: CC
prose: Orchestrator ask, 2026-11-12, follow-up to ticket c603e904432c: with local_executor now running the host's Git bash on Windows, test_record_is_permanent_and_complete goes red because it builds a 10000-character command (printf %s 'xxxx...') and hands it as argv. Measured on akiendell: Git bash takes a command line of 8000 characters and fails at 9000. A production relay command longer than about 8191 characters would now fail on Windows too: that is a real limit of the relay's local executor there, not only a fixture limit, and it is recorded here rather than fixed.
